_comment: Advisories that are outstanding and have been looked at. HQ-1043.
An advisory NOT listed here fails the build, so a new one gets a person's attention.
An advisory listed here does not, so a tree that passed yesterday does not go red today
Every entry needs a date and a reason someone else can check. 'accepted' is not a place
to park things indefinitely: if the reason is 'no fix exists yet', that is fine and it
should come out when one does. The checker reports entries that are no longer reported,
so cleaning up is prompted rather than remembered.
Both packages are clean as of 2026-09-10, which is why both are empty. That is the
state to try to stay in.

GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j.reason: @grpc/grpc-js 1.9.16 is pinned (~1.9.0) by @firebase/firestore, even in its latest release 4.20.0, so no non-major or any current client release carries the fix (<=1.13.5 affected). It is only reachable through the Firestore client SDK, which web/ loads only in rules.emulator.test.ts (dev). The shipped client imports firebase/app and firebase/auth only, and the server uses firebase-admin, whose grpc-js is 1.14.7 (patched). Remove when @firebase/firestore moves its grpc-js range.
